_readme: HUMAN OVERRIDES for ru. Hand-maintained; always wins.
scripts/translate.mjs READS this file and merges it on top of DeepL's output.
It never writes here. Fix a bad translation by adding the key HERE, not in
ru.json, which is regenerated on every run.
Every entry was written by Claude, not a native speaker -- see
TRANSLATION_NOTES.md. Nothing here has been verified by a human.
Keys must match public/locales/en.json. {placeholder} tokens and emoji must
match the English exactly or the generator refuses to write the locale.
keyword_language_label: На каком языке твои ключевые слова?

error_keyword_required: Перед отправкой введи хотя бы одно ключевое слово.
session_complete_detail: Ты прошёл {maxRounds} раундов. Начни новую сессию, чтобы сыграть ещё раз.
